title: Penne alla Vodka
description: Penne in a silky, blush-pink tomato cream sauce with a splash of vodka, garlic, chili flakes and plenty of Parmesan.

image.alt: A bowl of penne in a creamy pink tomato sauce

steps.text: Cook the penne in a big pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Save {qty 1 cup fixed} of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile melt the butter with the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Cook the shallot until soft, {time 3 min}, then the garlic and pepper flakes for {time 1 min}.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring, until it darkens to a brick red, {time 3-4 min}.
Take the pan off the heat and pour in the vodka, then return it to the heat and simmer, scraping, until it mostly evaporates, {time 1-2 min}. Stir in the cream and salt and simmer for {time 2 min}.
Add the pasta, the cheese and a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy. Serve topped with basil.

notes: The vodka sharpens the tomato flavor; most of the alcohol cooks off. Leave it out and use extra pasta water if you prefer.
